Lynn BE KIND ITS FREE!!!!!!

Lynn has been looking after our indoor cat during every trip we have taken since moving to Spring Branch a few years ago. We haven't been away from the house much, but Lynn has taken great care of our cat each time. During our time away, she regularly sends us updates on our cat's activities. Lynn is also extremely conscientious about security and works to keep the house from looking unoccupied.

Lynn is great for your cat sitting needs. She’s very thorough and asks very thoughtful questions when you have your initial consultation (things I didn’t even think about). She really cares about your pet(s) and their wellbeing while you’re away. I highly recommend for those in the Spring Branch area with any pet sitting needs!
